batch1.img: storybook 2D illustration, colorful, fun, expressive, 16:9, duck eggs being packed in clay and ash by hands, traditional chinese setting

batch1.tts: The yolk goes creamy and greenish. It smells like strong cheese mixed with... a chemistry lab.

batch1.tts: The patterns on the white look like pine branches. Chefs actually call it the pine-patterned egg. Fancy!
